li.text: The ruins you found were looted and scavenged. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has expired.

rulesStrings.li: questDescription->[scannerName] spent days at the [scanBuilding] going through [sources], and finally [clue]. Checked against old maps, it all points to one spot: a group of ancient buildings, very old and abandoned, but with doors still sealed and all inventory and machinery still inside.\n\nUnfortunately, those sources were never yours alone. [leak] All nearby settlements are already preparing to fight for whatever lies inside these ruins. The treasure could be enormous, so be prepared for a real massacre, not like the usual carefully balanced encounters you've had before. And don't waste time: scavengers are already on their way, and the ruins won't last long.
sources->a crate of water-damaged books from before the collapse
sources->old survey records bought from a trader for a handful of silver
sources->the journals of a long-dead exploration party
sources->a dozen folk tales that contradict each other in every detail but one
sources->the ledgers of a trading company that no longer exists
clue->found the same unmarked depot mentioned in three unrelated sources
clue->noticed that an old supply route ends at a place no map bothers to name
clue->matched a hand-drawn sketch in a margin to the shape of a nearby valley
clue->decoded a quartermaster's notes about a stockpile that was never collected
leak->Other settlements keep copies of the same books, and someone else was reading them at the same time.
leak->The trader who sold you the records had sold the same bundle to every settlement around.
leak->Asking passing caravans about old landmarks was a mistake: they put two and two together faster than you did.
leak->The scouts you sent to confirm the location were seen, and followed.

questDescription->After days of [listening] at the [scanBuilding], [scannerName] finally picked out [signal]. Triangulation points to a group of ancient buildings: the complex is very old and abandoned, but its doors are still sealed and all inventory and machinery is still inside.\n\nUnfortunately, you weren't the only ones listening. [leak] All nearby settlements are already preparing to fight for whatever lies inside these ruins. The treasure could be enormous, so be prepared for a real massacre, not like the usual carefully balanced encounters you've had before. And don't waste time: scavengers are already on their way, and the ruins won't last long.
listening->sweeping old frequencies
listening->pinging long-silent transponder codes
listening->hacking into a derelict satellite relay
listening->triangulating stray transmissions
signal->a faint automated beacon repeating the same distress code it has been sending for centuries
signal->a cluster of shielded power signatures where there should be nothing at all
signal->a dormant security network quietly answering each of your pings
signal->an encrypted maintenance channel that finally cracked open on the hundredth try
leak->Your active pings woke up the complex's own beacon, and it is now broadcasting its position on every band.
leak->Your triangulation pings were loud enough for every comms array in the region to trace them to the same spot.
leak->A passing trader intercepted your comms traffic and is selling the coordinates to anyone willing to pay.
leak->The moment you narrowed it down, the old security network started answering everyone, not just you.
